cite.quote: Use a button or a plain-text URL, not both. A message carrying both leaves the URL unclickable on desktop, so a desktop reader ends up with no working link at all.

cite.quote: On a follow gate the button is a confirm button, not a link, so removing it is not an option. Ask for a typed reply in the gate message instead, for example "Reply FOLLOWING once you have." Blotato runs the follower check on any text reply.

entries.opening: Yes, there is a follow gate for Instagram. Here is how it works.

steps.text: Follow gating works on Instagram. Turn on Ask for a follow in the automation.

cite.quote: Yes, on Instagram. Turn on Ask for a follow in the automation.

steps.text: Blotato sends your gate message with a confirm button, waits up to 30 days for a reply, then checks whether the person follows you.

cite.quote: Blotato sends your gate message with a confirm button, waits up to 30 days for a reply, then checks whether the person follows you.

steps.text: A follower gets your link. Someone who does not follow gets the gate message again.

cite.quote: A follower gets your link. Someone who does not follow gets the gate message again.

steps.text: If you connected the account before follow gating landed, reconnect it in Accounts. An older connection does not reliably receive the tap, and runs stall until they expire.

cite.quote: Reconnect the account if you connected it before follow gating landed. Blotato subscribes your account to button-tap events at connect time, so an older connection does not reliably receive the tap and runs stall until they expire. Reconnect in Accounts.

steps.text: Ask for a typed reply in the gate message, such as "Reply FOLLOWING once you have." Instagram shows DM buttons in the mobile app only, so a desktop reader sees no button, and Blotato runs the follower check on any text reply.

cite.quote: Ask for a typed reply in the gate message. Instagram shows DM buttons in the mobile app only, so a desktop reader sees no button. Blotato runs the follower check on any text reply, so wording like "Reply FOLLOWING once you have" moves a desktop reader forward the same way the button moves a mobile reader.

entries.next: If your account was connected before follow gating landed, reconnect it in Accounts, then turn on Ask for a follow and write a gate message that asks for a typed reply.
entries.proof: You will know it worked when a person who follows you replies to the gate message and gets your link.

entries.opening: Analytics arrive on a delay, and a few conditions can hold them back. Here is what to check.

steps.text: Analytics need a paid plan. On the free trial, or if your plan does not include analytics, posts show "Analytics not available."

cite.quote: Data is not instant. Blotato collects the first metrics on a schedule after a post publishes (around 2 hours on Creator and Agency, up to 1 day on Starter), then again at later checkpoints. A post published minutes ago shows no metrics until the first checkpoint passes.

steps.text: Blotato stops collecting if the social account is disconnected or its token expired. Reconnect it in Accounts through its account actions menu > Reconnect. If the account was connected before the analytics permissions were granted, check the connection and any error it shows, and reconnect when authorization is missing or expired. Reconnecting does not bring back metrics for older posts, and it does not guarantee metrics within 24-48 hours.

cite.quote: If the social account is disconnected or its token expired, Blotato stops collecting. Reconnect the account in Accounts through its account actions menu > Reconnect. 5. If the account was connected before the required analytics permissions were granted, inspect the connection and any returned error. Reconnect when authorization is missing or expired. entries.opening: Analytics are not live. They are collected at fixed points after a post publishes.

steps.text: Blotato does not refresh analytics continuously. It collects a snapshot of each post's metrics at fixed checkpoints, counted from when the post publishes.

cite.quote: Blotato does not refresh analytics continuously. It collects a snapshot of each post's metrics at fixed checkpoints, measured from when the post publishes.

steps.text: Starter has 4 checkpoints over 30 days: 1, 7, 14 and 30 days after publish.

cite.quote: Starter -- 4 checkpoints over 30 days 1 day after publish 7 days after publish 14 days after publish 30 days after publish

steps.text: Creator has 18 checkpoints over 30 days: 2 hours after publish, every day from day 1 through day 8, then days 10, 12, 14, 17, 20, 22, 24, 27, and 30.

cite.quote: Creator -- 18 checkpoints over 30 days 2 hours after publish Every day from day 1 through day 8 Days 10, 12, 14, 17, 20, 22, 24, 27, and 30

steps.text: Agency has 20 checkpoints over 90 days: 2 hours and 6 hours after publish, every day from day 1 through day 8, days 10, 12, 14, 17, 20, 22, 24, 27, and 30, and day 90.

cite.quote: Agency -- 20 checkpoints over 90 days 2 hours and 6 hours after publish Every day from day 1 through day 8 Days 10, 12, 14, 17, 20, 22, 24, 27, and 30 Day 90

steps.text: Exact timing varies by a few minutes on the early checkpoints and up to a day on the 30-day and 90-day ones. The Published page and the API show the latest snapshot, not live data, and after the final checkpoint the last snapshot stays as the post's metrics.

cite.quote: Each checkpoint adds a small random offset to spread out collection, so exact timing varies by a few minutes on the early checkpoints and up to a day on the 30-day and 90-day ones. The Published page and the API return the latest snapshot Blotato collected. They do not pull live data from the social platform. After the final checkpoint, the last snapshot stays as the post's metrics.

entries.next: Check how long ago your post published against the checkpoints for your plan.
entries.proof: You will know it worked when you can match the post's age to the last checkpoint it has passed.

entries.opening: Pinterest verification happens automatically once you reconnect your account with 100+ monthly views.

steps.text: A new Pinterest account must be warmed up for 2 weeks before you connect it to a third-party posting tool like Blotato.

cite.quote: You MUST warm it up for 2 weeks before connecting to 3rd party posting tools like Blotato.

steps.text: Start posting 1 pin per day by hand, then ramp up to 2, then 3, and so on.

cite.quote: Start posting 1 pin per day manually, then gradually ramp up to 2, then 3, etc. pins per day.

steps.text: Once you get 100+ views per month, reconnect your Pinterest account with Blotato, and it will be verified automatically.

cite.quote: Once you get 100+ views per month, then reconnect your Pinterest account with Blotato and it will be automatically verified.

steps.text: Blotato no longer verifies Pinterest accounts manually, so there is no request to send. There is no manual override: 100 monthly views is the only thing that unlocks it.

cite.quote: Blotato no longer verifies Pinterest accounts manually. There is no request to send. Verification happens automatically once you reconnect with 100+ monthly views. There is no manual override -- the 100 monthly views threshold is the only unlock criterion.

entries.next: Post pins by hand for at least 2 weeks, starting at 1 a day and ramping up, then reconnect your Pinterest account with Blotato once it gets 100+ views a month.
entries.proof: You will know it worked when your Pinterest account is verified after you reconnect it with 100+ monthly views.
